events.title: Closest to Saturn
events.text: It passes 126 000 km from Saturn, and after Saturn heads north out of the plane of the planets.

events.title: Into interstellar space
events.text: It crosses the edge of the heliosphere with a working plasma instrument; Voyager 1's had stopped in 1980.

events.title: Launch
events.text: Galileo leaves the ground in the cargo bay of the space shuttle Atlantis.

events.title: Out of the shuttle
events.text: Atlantis lets Galileo and its upper stage go from the cargo bay, bound first for Venus.

events.title: Back past Earth
events.text: It swings past Earth 960 km up, onto a two-year orbit of the Sun.

events.title: The first asteroid visit
events.text: It passes 1 601 km from Gaspra, the first spacecraft to meet an asteroid.

events.title: Past Earth a second time
events.text: A second pass of Earth, 303 km up, sends it on towards Jupiter.

events.title: Into orbit round Jupiter
events.text: It enters orbit round Jupiter on the day its probe dives into the planet's atmosphere.

events.title: The last contact
events.text: Communications end. Dawn stays in orbit round Ceres.

events.title: Closest to Jupiter
events.text: It races past Jupiter at a range of 130 354 km.

events.title: Closest to Jupiter
events.text: It passes 42 500 km over Jupiter's cloud tops, three times closer than Pioneer 10.

events.title: The first full-colour pictures
events.text: ESA shows Euclid's first images: the Perseus Cluster, IC 342, NGC 6822, NGC 6397 and the Horsehead Nebula.

events.title: The first big batch of data
events.text: ESA releases DR1-Foundation: 13 months of observations, 1900 square degrees of sky, over a billion objects.

source.name: NASA NSSDCA, Apollo 11 Command and Service Module

events.title: Apollo 17, at night
events.text: The last crew to the Moon leaves after a delay of 2 hours 40 minutes: the first night launch of an Apollo.

events.title: The last Shuttle from 39B
events.text: Discovery launches at night on STS-116, the last Space Shuttle to leave from this pad.

events.title: Past Hartley 2
events.text: On an extended mission it flies past a second comet, Hartley 2.

events.title: Past Venus
events.text: It passes 34 773 km from Venus, the first spacecraft to fly past another planet.

events.title: Europa and Io, on the way in
events.text: While the probe is still approaching, the orbiter passes Europa and then Io.

events.title: Into Jupiter’s air
events.text: It meets Jupiter’s atmosphere at 47.6 km per second, then sends data for 58 minutes on a parachute. JPL’s path for it ends at this minute.

events.title: Two become one
events.text: The shuttle Endeavour's robot arm captures Zarya and mates it to Unity: the first two modules are joined.

events.title: People move in
events.text: Expedition 1 docks. The station has been continuously inhabited since.
